search.primary_policy: Primary papers, official code, author/institution publication pages; inaccessible leads retained without theorem conclusions.
query_families: random row-scaled matrix generic rank and matroid union
Fano packing and invariance of domain
coverage_limits: Not an exhaustive bibliographic or forward-citation search.
Some long stronger-engine searches returned irrelevant single-term matches; direct retrieval and the second engine partly repaired coverage.
No theorem-level conclusion is drawn from search snippets.
Publication dates are precise only when primary metadata supports them.
No empirical experiments or benchmarks were run for this audit.

new_theory_status: Candidate construction communicated by theory agent; proof acceptance belongs to separate Phase9 review. No frozen theory file modified.

sources.title: Towards Making Systems Forget with Machine Unlearning

publication.venue: IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy

sources.supported_comparison: Pipeline stages and summation-form maintenance are prior.
sources.our_scope_distinction: We study one nonmonotone curator and its bounded-future information requirement.

sources.title: ARCANE: An Efficient Architecture for Exact Machine Unlearning
sources.supported_comparison: Section 3.2 uses representative selection and treats unselected-example removal as requiring no retraining.
sources.our_scope_distinction: Different full-curator rerun target; not a blanket refutation of ARCANE.

sources.title: DBSP: Automatic Incremental View Maintenance for Rich Query Languages
sources.supported_comparison: Nonmonotone relational maintenance, negation, and aggregation are established.
sources.our_scope_distinction: Antijoin formulation is our application; restricted future-state information is the proposed distinction.

sources.title: PrIU: A Provenance-Based Approach for Incrementally Updating Regression Models
sources.supported_comparison: Polynomial vector/matrix provenance updates regression models.
sources.our_scope_distinction: Selector-specific bounded-horizon state, not first provenance model repair.

sources.title: F-IVM: Incremental View Maintenance with Triple Lock Factorization Benefits
sources.supported_comparison: Section 7.2 maintains regression cofactor aggregates over changing relational data.
sources.our_scope_distinction: Ridge moments and signed updates are supporting tools.

sources.title: DBToaster: Higher-order Delta Processing for Dynamic, Frequently Fresh Views
sources.supported_comparison: Higher-order deltas and materialized dynamic views predate this work.
sources.our_scope_distinction: Our finite-horizon selector representation is a specialization.

sources.title: Exact Federated Continual Unlearning for Ridge Heads on Frozen Foundation Models
sources.supported_comparison: Additive Gram/cross moments give exact-arithmetic ridge add/delete maintenance.
sources.our_scope_distinction: Raw withdrawal must determine and recover newly admitted retained contributions.

sources.title: The Space Complexity of Learning-Unlearning Algorithms
sources.supported_comparison: Bounded-deletion memory lower bounds and entropy reductions already exist; full version Section 6 addresses realizability.
sources.our_scope_distinction: Prescribed ridge output, shared semantic geometry, and fixed forgotten payloads distinguish the proposed family.
limitations: PMLR item is an extended abstract; detailed theorem comparison uses arXiv v1.

sources.title: Ticketed Learning–Unlearning Schemes
sources.supported_comparison: Ticketed state changes the central-memory model.
sources.our_scope_distinction: Charge tickets, deleted payloads, and external hidden-information caches explicitly.
limitations: Full proof comparison also appears in the earlier local literature audit; this refresh retrieved archival metadata/abstract.

sources.title: Deletion-Robust Submodular Maximization: Data Summarization with the Right to be Forgotten
sources.supported_comparison: Deletion-robust summaries and approximate recovery are prior.
sources.our_scope_distinction: A designated curator/model output differs from any high-value feasible solution.

sources.title: Scalable Deletion-Robust Submodular Maximization: Data Summarization with Privacy and Fairness Constraints
sources.supported_comparison: Scalable central, streaming, and distributed robust summarization is established.
sources.our_scope_distinction: Exact pipeline reproduction is a different target from objective approximation.

sources.title: Coresets remembered and items forgotten: submodular maximization with deletions
sources.supported_comparison: Explicitly studies the number of items remembered before bounded adversarial deletions.
sources.our_scope_distinction: Memory dependence on deletion budget alone is not novel.

sources.title: Deletion Robust Non-Monotone Submodular Maximization over Matroids
sources.supported_comparison: Small robust summaries extend to nonmonotone objectives and matroid constraints.
sources.our_scope_distinction: Not an exact designated-curator/model reconstruction theorem.

sources.title: Coresets for Deletion-Robust k-Center Clustering
sources.supported_comparison: Geometric robust coresets with approximation guarantees are prior.
sources.our_scope_distinction: Our specified ridge output has a different recovery objective.
limitations: Linked author PDF https://honokakousaka.github.io/files/sp2604-li.pdf returned 404; no proof-level comparison.

sources.title: A General Framework for Dynamic Consistent Submodular Maximization
sources.supported_comparison: Dynamic approximate solutions with controlled recourse/consistency are established.
sources.our_scope_distinction: Low replacement count and backup summaries alone are insufficient novelty.

sources.title: Control, Confidentiality, and the Right to be Forgotten
sources.supported_comparison: Adaptive history independence and deletion/privacy distinctions are established.
sources.our_scope_distinction: Logical canonical state is narrower than physical or transcript guarantees.

sources.title: Strongly History-Independent Hashing with Applications
sources.supported_comparison: Strong history-independent data structures predate this work.
sources.our_scope_distinction: Our canonical summary representation is application-specific, not a new general history-independence result.

sources.title: Machine Unlearning as Private Retroactive Algorithms
sources.supported_comparison: Retroactive maintenance and continual-observation privacy are distinguished explicitly.
sources.our_scope_distinction: Retraining equivalence alone does not establish release-sequence privacy.

sources.title: When Does an Ensemble of Matrices with Randomly Scaled Rows Lose Rank?

publication.venue: arXiv; metadata mentions ISIT short version and IEEE IT submission

sources.supported_comparison: Theorem 1 and Section III derive generic rank for row-scaled concatenated blocks using matroid union.
sources.our_scope_distinction: Our public-feature tensor-column matrix transposes to this established family.
limitations: No journal publication date is inferred from submission metadata.

sources.title: SemDeDup: Data-efficient learning at web-scale through semantic deduplication
sources.supported_comparison: Fixed within-cluster earlier-raw-neighbor suppression is supported by the pinned implementation.
sources.our_scope_distinction: Full clustering/order refitting is not automatically restriction-consistent.

sources.title: Official SemDeDup implementation
sources.supported_comparison: Upper-triangle maximum and strict threshold predicate implement raw-neighbor suppression.
sources.our_scope_distinction: Fixed graph/global variant must be named separately from corpus-fitted full replay.
limitations: Web blob rendering failed in this pass; exact vendored bytes and acquisition manifest were inspected.
Padding zeros and singleton special case matter for boundary thresholds.

sources.title: D4: Improving LLM pretraining via document de-duplication and diversification
sources.supported_comparison: Reclustering occurs after semantic deduplication and is explicitly ablated.
sources.our_scope_distinction: Frozen-curator repair does not reproduce full D4.

sources.title: What to Forget in Unlearning? Forget Set Curation for Language Models
sources.supported_comparison: Maps behavioral suppression requests to unlearning forget sets.
sources.our_scope_distinction: Our input withdrawal is specified; the original training curator is rerun.

sources.title: Natively Unlearnable Large Language Models
sources.supported_comparison: Source-specific neural parameter allocation supports source unlearning.
sources.our_scope_distinction: Different mechanism and target from counterfactual semantic selection.

sources.title: An Introductory Guide to Fano's Inequality with Applications in Statistical Estimation
sources.supported_comparison: Theorem 1 and Section 5.2 give standard finite-alphabet Fano and packing reductions.
sources.our_scope_distinction: The realized ridge/cosine family is the proposed new application, not the information inequality.

sources.title: Algebraic Topology, Theorem 2B.3
sources.supported_comparison: Classical invariance of domain rules out lower-dimensional continuous injective encodings of an open chart.
sources.our_scope_distinction: Does not apply to unrestricted discontinuous real encodings.
limitations: The theorem is attributed to Brouwer; this is an author-hosted proof exposition, not a claim of original discovery by Hatcher.

sources.title: End-to-end machine unlearning through data preparation pipelines and feature stores
sources.supported_comparison: Author/lab metadata identifies a highly relevant pipeline thesis.
sources.our_scope_distinction: Theorem-level comparison remains unresolved.
limitations: Graduation 2025-08-28 is not asserted as publication date.

sources.title: Predictive State Is Not Explanatory State: An Exponential Memory Separation Between Forecasting and Counterfactual Auditing
sources.supported_comparison: Abstract claims logarithmic predictive bits versus linear counterfactual bits for binary-history processes, also under approximate recovery. General prediction-versus-audit memory separation is therefore a concrete prior claim.
sources.our_scope_distinction: Realizable shared-cosine ridge-head family and exact success-model comparison still need full-text review.
limitations: Direct landing/PDF retrieval failed; search returned the primary cached abstract.
Proof, precise query family, and approximate-success semantics remain unresolved.

sources.title: GRACE: Gradient-guided Coreset Selection for LLM Unlearning
sources.supported_comparison: Earlier audit found an abstract-level coreset-selection lead.
sources.our_scope_distinction: Detailed comparison remains unavailable.
limitations: Direct primary retrieval failed in this pass.
Do not infer exact date or theorem scope from identifier alone.
